Convert Swiss Addresses to Coordinates

Source: R/geocode.R
geocode.Rd

Geocodes addresses with the search service of the Swiss federal geoportal (api3.geo.admin.ch, origin address, based on the federal building and dwelling register). Use it to place customers, patients or sites on a map and, with locate(), to assign them to municipalities.

Usage

geocode(x, output = c("data.frame", "sf"))

Arguments

x

character vector of addresses, e.g. "Waldwis 4 Madetswil".

output

"data.frame", or "sf" for an sf point object (rows without a match dropped).

Value

One row per address with adresse_x (query), treffer_x (matched address), n_treffer_n (number of hits), x, y (LV95), lat_n and lon_n.

Details

Coordinates are returned in LV95 (EPSG:2056) with x as easting and y as northing, matching the maps of this package, and as WGS84 latitude and longitude. Only the best match per address is kept; n_treffer_n tells whether the address was ambiguous. Addresses without a match give a row of NA.

See also

locate().

Other swiss.spatial: combineRegions(), locate(), neighbours()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
adr <- geocode(c("Bundesplatz 3 Bern", "Quaderaweg 3 Trimmis"))
locate(adr$x, adr$y)
} # }
